### Being Confident Around Men: Inspired by Biblical Women

Image

Being Confident Around Men: Inspired by Biblical Women helps Christian women grow in biblical confidence, discernment, feminine strength, and Christ-centered relational wisdom through the example of faithful women in Scripture. Students learn healthy boundaries, embodied holiness, emotional steadiness, and peaceful confidence in mixed-gender relationships, ministry, and everyday life.

Category: Christian Growth - Coaching Support Courses

### BIB 111 - Old Testament Survey (3 credits)

Image

This ministry training course examines the historical writings of the Old Testament, focusing on the stories of God's dealings with Israel in preparation for the coming of Jesus Christ. The class also shows some applications for contemporary Christian living and preaching. (The Old Testament's detailed laws, Psalms, wisdom writings, and prophets are featured in other classes.)

Category: Bible/Theology Studies

### BIB 340 - Biblical Wisdom Books (4 credits)

Image

This ministry training course examines the wisdom writings of Old Testament sages and poets: Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Song of Songs, and Lamentations. The class shows the relevance of Old Testament wisdom for knowing God's wisdom in Christ and following Jesus today.

Category: Bible/Theology Studies

### Building a Life Coach Ministry Practice

Image

Building a Life Coaching Ministry Practice equips Life Coach Ministers to develop accountable, Christ-centered coaching ministries.
Newman. Victoria is a writer, speaker, and consultant for communities that faithfully practice belonging with persons of all abilities. Currently the THRIVE Program Director at The King’s Table Ministries in Grand Rapids, MI, she serves local churches by connecting them with neighboring adult foster care group homes. 

Category: Ministry Skills

### ECN 201 - Introduction to Economics (3 credits) - OLD VERSION

Image

This class teaches basic principles of economics and applies them to practical entrepreneurship. This helps ministry-minded leaders to develop valuable skills for reaching more people for Christ and providing for their families.﻿﻿

### Fellowship and Hospitality Ministry

Image

Fellowship and Hospitality are two the pillars of church growth and discipleship! This course is lead by Henry and Pam Reyenga who have been involved with ministry for over 4 decades. Gain valuable insights into this important ministry area. 

Category: Ministry Skills

### SOC 201 - Introduction to Sociology (3 Cr)

Image

This general education core class explores the academic discipline of sociology, evaluates claims of sociology from a biblical perspective, and shows how understanding of social structures and relationships can make ministry more effective.

Category: Sociology

### Soul Center Registration

Register your soul center as a religious society with the Christian Leaders Alliance. Soul Centers gives you a local ministry presence connecting Christian Leaders Alliance Credentials to your local ministry context. 

Category: Soul Centers

### Soul Coach Ordination Program

Image

The Soul Coach Ordination Program prepares Christ-centered leaders to serve others through prayer, encouragement, biblical wisdom, and faithful next-step support as ordained Soul Coaches. Students learn to walk alongside people with humility, healthy boundaries, and Spirit-led care while helping them grow through Christian Growth resources and local ministry.

Category: Life Coaching Ordination Program Courses

### Soulful Sleeping: Slumber Better in Faith

Image

Soulful Sleeping: This ministry sciences study will help you sleep better and give you a tool to minister to others for better slumber.

Category: Christian Growth - Coaching Support Courses
